title: [FMLA 20] ElasticEnergy — Elastic Energy
summary: Potential energy stored in a stretched/compressed spring.

body.text: Calculator scroll name: ElasticEnergy. Potential energy stored in a stretched/compressed spring.
A stretched or compressed spring holds energy you can get back. U = ½ K x². x = 0 (unstretched) holds nothing.

body.caption: Energy stored versus stretch x (example K = 1). The U-shape means twice the stretch stores four times the energy.

body.title: How to run
items: Press FMLA, then 2, then 0 (or scroll to the name and EXE)

body.label: Units
body.text: SI: K in N/m, x in m (both > 0); energy U in J.
